instruction: A cinematic medium shot still of a bright indoor dance studio with large arched windows. On the left, the man in the blue t-shirt and pink shorts (R2) is shown in profile facing right, holding his arms bent in an active aerobics pose. On the right, the woman in the light blue leotard and white tights (R1) stands in profile facing right, extending her arms forward to clap. The man and the woman perform synchronized dance moves back-to-back. Soft, natural daylight illuminates the scene with a clean, balanced color palette.
elements: R1 extends her arms forward to clap during the dance, while R2 does not take that clapping role
R2 holds his arms bent in an active aerobics pose, while R1 takes the forward-clapping role
R1 and R2 perform different but synchronized dance actions rather than swapping those actions
R1 and R2 are positioned back-to-back while dancing
